DBV (SOT-23), 6 pins: junction-to-ambient thermal resistance is 162 °C/W.

5.3 Recommended operating conditions, footnote 1
If the supply ramp is slower than recommended, run a wake-up and sleep cycle after power-up or power-up reset to avoid an I2C address glitch in sleep mode. Standby and continuous modes do not require this action.
